dataset: UCI Ozone Level Detection, onehr.data only
citation: Zhang K, Fan W, Yuan X (2008). Ozone Level Detection. UCI Machine Learning Repository.
license: CC BY 4.0, as stated on UCI dataset page
target: last column: 1 ozone day, 0 normal day; original labels retained
features: 72 numeric predictors; first/date column excluded per source names file; ? becomes missing
selection: one-hour task chosen for natural positive fraction below 5%; prevalence inspected before protocol freeze; no model/certificate outcomes inspected
curation: all 2536 rows retained; no resampling, class weighting, label-dependent removal or positive subsampling
splits: StratifiedGroupKFold 4 folds, shuffled: fold 0 validation, fold 1 reserved test, folds 2+3 train; feature-identical groups determined without labels, missing values kept in grouping; approximate 50/25/25; not chronological
models: LR C=1 max_iter=2000; training-median imputation and standardization
RF 120 trees min_samples_leaf=5 max_features=sqrt; training-median imputation
timing: one callable per case including solver preparation; excludes fitting, loading and independent witness checks; no comparative speedup
limitations: one naturally rare-positive benchmark; dependent splits, not extreme-imbalance universality; temporal observations with random splits do not establish future forecasting accuracy; no test predictions
